name: Tianjin Chase Sun Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd
summary: Tianjin Chase Sun Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of various pharmaceutical products in China. The company offers traditional Chinese medicine formula granules; finished drugs, including xuebijing injections, low molecular weight heparin calcium injections, moxifloxacin hydrochloride sodium chloride injections, enoxaparin sodium injections, nadronexacin calcium injections, fasudil hydrochloride injections, ketorheic acid tromethamine injections, ibanoxetine sodium injections, Qingfei Sanjie pills, and Ping Wan anti-cancer pills; raw materials and excipients, such as pharmaceutical excipients, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and food…
